lead.default: A clear point of view, built into the everyday experience.

default.heading: Start with what matters.
default.body: A shared direction should be easy to see. Put priorities, owners, and next steps close to the work.

default.heading: Keep the thinking, too.
default.body: A decision is more useful when its reasoning comes with it. Make knowledge part of the workflow.

default.heading: Leave room to focus.
default.body: Good systems support attention instead of competing for it. Choose useful defaults over extra noise.
